title: fix(components,fields): head a widget-hinted nameField through its face (objectui#13216)
body:
Fixes #13216
Clause-②: yes

## Summary

`page:header`'s declared-pointer rung printed a `nameField`'s stored text even when that field declares a widget whose read face names the value. `sys_record_share` declares `nameField: 'recipient_id'`, and that field declares `widget: 'recipient-picker'` with `dependsOn: ['recipient_type']`, so a record share's H1 was the recipient's raw user id while its list column already drew the user's name.

Route A, the registry bridge, as claimed:

- `@object-ui/components` owns a field-face seam (`lib/field-face.ts`): one setter, `setFieldReadFaceResolver`, and one reader, `resolveFieldReadFace`, on the package entry.
- `@object-ui/fields` fills it when its entry module loads, with the lookup the grid's cells make, `getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(field))`. The answer is bounded to the keys a declared widget promotes to (`WIDGET_CELL_RENDERER_TYPES`), and only once a host has registered a face there. The key's default face is the stored text (`TextCellRenderer`), which is what the heading already prints, so that case answers no face. `@object-ui/components` does not import `@object-ui/fields`, so no package cycle closes.
- `page:header` asks the seam for the declared `nameField`'s face when the pointer rung is the one that answers (no explicit `title`, and a value on the record). When a face resolves, the rung draws the stored value through it, with the whole record as `dependentValues`, so `recipient_type` reaches the face's `dependsOn` read. Otherwise every rung heads exactly as before. `containers.tsx` names no widget; the declaration decides.
- `RecordTitleChip` gains an optional `titleNode` slot drawn inside its `h1`. `title` stays a required `string` for every caller.

Out of scope, as the claim says: `RecipientPickerField` and the face itself, the server's declaration, and any name-to-label mapping in the console.

## Patch round 1

CI on `7f8be05a7` (Test shard 11/16) failed `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, "declares no name twice outside the named, shrinking baseline". The failure was `FieldFace — a NEW colliding name`: the new export collided with app-shell's own `FieldFace` in `views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`, the union naming which control `FieldControl` renders. The two are different things, and `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` only shrinks, so app-shell is untouched. Instead, the unpublished family was renamed together at `85fa87048`:

- `FieldFace` → `FieldReadFace`
- `FieldFaceProps` → `FieldReadFaceProps`
- `FieldFaceResolver` → `FieldReadFaceResolver`
- `setFieldFaceResolver` → `setFieldReadFaceResolver`
- `resolveFieldFace` → `resolveFieldReadFace`

The rename covers both packages' source, the four test files, the README, `content/docs/guide/fields.md` and the changeset. `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` named none of them. The file `lib/field-face.ts` keeps its name, and its header now says why the names say READ. App-shell's `SchemaForm.tsx` also exports a `resolveFieldFace`; the gate named only `FieldFace`, and the rename clears both. None of the five new names occurs anywhere else in the tree (`git grep -w`, zero hits before the rename).

Readings at `85fa87048`, each exit code captured before any pipe:

- The failed gate: `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` exits 0, with 11 tests passed. Control: putting `export type FieldFace = ` back in `lib/field-face.ts` turns it red again ("FieldFace — a NEW colliding name"), and the restore was proven (blob equals HEAD, empty `git diff HEAD`).
- `git grep -n -w -E "FieldFace|FieldFaceProps|FieldFaceResolver|setFieldFaceResolver|resolveFieldFace"` hits under `packages/app-shell/` only. The hits are its own `FieldFace` and `resolveFieldFace` with their `SchemaForm` tests, its CHANGELOG, a file-local `FieldFace` component in `RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx`, and a comment in `predicate.ts`.
- The four new test files plus every components test file naming `containers`, `page:header` or `RecordTitleChip`: 48 files, 636 tests passed, exit 0.
- `@object-ui/components` `type-check` exits 0 and `lint` exits 0 (0 errors). `@object-ui/fields` `type-check` exits 0, after the `'@object-ui/fields^...'` closure rebuild; its `lint` exits 0 (0 errors). The rebuilt `dist` types carry the new names.
- The docs and changeset gates exit 0 each: `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `docs:check-links`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:self-import`.
- The README snippet still compiles under `--strict` against the rebuilt `dist`, with a red control. `check:readme-exports --list` judges `resolveFieldReadFace` and `FieldReadFace` `real`.

No ablation was re-run: this round renames, and behaviour does not change. The Tests and Gates sections below are the round-0 readings at `7f8be05a7`, and the renamed names in them are the same symbols.

## Contract surface

Every export, prop and type member this diff adds. All are additive, and nothing existing is renamed, removed or narrowed.

`@object-ui/components`, on the package entry (`src/index.ts`):

| Added | Kind | Shape |
|---|---|---|
| `setFieldReadFaceResolver` | function | takes one argument, a `FieldReadFaceResolver` or `undefined`, and returns `void`. The last install wins; `undefined` removes the resolver. |
| `resolveFieldReadFace` | function | takes a `FieldMetadata` (or `null` / `undefined`) and returns a `FieldReadFace` or `undefined`. It answers `undefined` when no resolver is installed, the field is absent, or the resolver answers none. |
| `FieldReadFace` | type | `React.ComponentType` over `FieldReadFaceProps` |
| `FieldReadFaceResolver` | type | a function from `FieldMetadata` to `FieldReadFace` or `undefined` |
| `FieldReadFaceProps` | interface | three members, listed in the next three rows |
| `FieldReadFaceProps.value` | member | `unknown`, the field's stored value |
| `FieldReadFaceProps.field` | member | `FieldMetadata` (from `@object-ui/types`), the field's declaration |
| `FieldReadFaceProps.dependentValues` | member | optional, a string-keyed record of `unknown` values: the whole record, for a face that reads a sibling |
| `RecordTitleChipProps.titleNode` | prop | optional `React.ReactNode`, drawn inside the `h1` in place of `title`'s text |

`FieldReadFaceProps` is the subset of `@object-ui/fields`' `CellRendererProps` the heading passes, so a registered cell renderer is a `FieldReadFace` without a cast. The fields package's `type-check` (which reads this package's built `dist` types) is green with its resolver typed that way.

`@object-ui/fields`: no export added. Its entry module now calls `setFieldReadFaceResolver` at load with an unexported function. `sideEffects` is `true` on both packages, so no bundler drops that call.

## Mechanism readings (the PM's hypotheses, measured)

- **H1 holds.** objectui's `.objectstack-sha` is `06cab4849a8a616487d468a11dd370e929137990`. `git merge-base --is-ancestor 99e4eaa227 06cab4849a8a` exits 0 in the objectstack checkout, and that exit code proves the ancestry on its own. At the pin, `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-record-share.object.ts` carries `nameField: 'recipient_id'`. Under `recipient_id: Field.text({`, it carries `widget: 'recipient-picker',` and `dependsOn: ['recipient_type'],`. All three were read with `git show` at the pin.
- **H2 holds, with one refinement.** The face is a component with an async label (`RecipientCellFace` reads `useRecipientLabel(value, dependentValues)`), so the H1 renders a node, with the whole record as the row. The refinement: the fields resolver answers no face while the widget's key still draws the package default (the stored text). A host that loads `@object-ui/fields` but registers no face under the key therefore keeps today's string heading, not an equivalent heading drawn through `TextCellRenderer`. There is no per-widget case in `containers.tsx`.
- **H3: a plain module value is enough.** The reading comes from code and from Chromium.
  - Console: `apps/console/src/main.tsx` statically imports `@object-ui/app-shell`. App-shell's entry statically imports `views/widget-ref-cells/widget-ref-cell-renderers`, which statically imports `@object-ui/fields` and registers `RecipientCell` at module load. ESM evaluates both before the entry's body calls `render`.
  - The showcase is served from that same console bundle.
  - Every other `page:header` host that gives the header a record (`RecordDetailView`, `PagePreview` and `DetailView` in `plugin-detail`) statically imports `@object-ui/fields`.
  - Chromium measured it: a scratch Vite entry mounted the real `RecordDetailView` the way the console does. Its module body, before the first `render`, read `resolveFieldReadFace` for a `recipient-picker` field and got `RecipientCell`.
  - So no subscription was added. The seam's doc comment states the bound: a host that loaded `@object-ui/fields` only after the first render would draw the stored text until its next render.
- **H4: the text readers keep the stored value.** This is a code reading. No synchronous label path was added.
  - `document.title`: the console's `AppShell` is the one writer. `ConsoleLayout` passes it `branding.title` (app label and product name), so the record's title never reaches the tab.
  - `aria-label`: the `header` element takes only `page:header`'s own `aria` bag, and the `h1` has none. Its accessible name is its text, which is now the face's text (the stored id until the label read lands, then the name).
  - Breadcrumb, favourite and recent-item labels: `RecordDetailView` derives `recordTitle` with `getRecordDisplayName(objectDef, readablePageRecord)` and passes it to `useRecordBreadcrumbTitle`, `addRecentItem` and `refreshFavoriteLabel`. These read the stored value. For a select `nameField`, `getRecordDisplayName` applies no option label, so the select rung of objectui#13103 labels the H1 only, and the breadcrumb keeps the stored option value. They are unchanged by this PR.
- **H5 holds.** Each control heads exactly as before, each pinned in `page-header-title.widgetFace-13216.test.tsx`: a plain text `nameField`; a select `nameField` (the objectui#13103 option label); a title template; a record with no `nameField`; an explicit `title`; an empty pointer value; and a host where no resolver is installed. The existing `page-header-title.selectNameField-13103.test.tsx` pins pass unchanged.
- **H6 holds.** The acceptance pins go red with the fix reverted (ablation below), and the Chromium reading is below.

## Tests

New, beside each piece:

- `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-title.widgetFace-13216.test.tsx`: the real `page:header` with a stand-in resolver. It holds THE CARD (H1 reads "Ada Lovelace", not `usr_9f3`), the face's inputs (the value, the declaration, and the whole record with `recipient_type`), the array form of `fields`, the face outranking a `titleFormat`, and the seven controls above.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/record-title-chip.titleNode-13216.test.tsx`: the slot, plus a control without it.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/field-face.seam-13216.test.tsx`: the setter and reader.
- `packages/fields/src/__tests__/fieldFaceSeam-13216.test.tsx`: tests that the fields module load fills the seam. It answers no face while the key draws the default face. It answers the face a host registers, which is the same component as `getCellRenderer(resolveCellRendererType(field))`. Its controls are no widget, `filter-condition`, a select base type and a `format` hint. End to end, the real `page:header` over a `sys_record_share`-shaped record, with an async stand-in host face, heads with the user's name; with no host face it heads with the stored id.

Runs:

- the four new files: 4 files, 23 tests passed;
- every components test file that names `containers`, `page:header` or `RecordTitleChip`, plus the seam file: 47 files, 631 tests passed;
- every fields test file that names the cell-renderer registry: 91 files, 1521 passed, 7 skipped, with 1 file skipped by its own skip guard;
- the full package suites at `7f8be05a7` (repo-root form, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/PKG/`):
  - `packages/components/` exited 0, with 421 files passed and 1 skipped (422), and 4188 tests passed with 24 skipped;
  - `packages/fields/` exited 0, with 273 files passed and 1 skipped (274), and 4199 tests passed with 7 skipped.

Ablations (fix committed first; each mutation landed through `ablation-replace.mjs` with anchor counts and blob hashes checked on disk; each restore was proven to have `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`; vitest resolves both packages to `src` through the root alias, so there is no `dist` leg):

| Mutation | Red | Green |
|---|---|---|
| drop `titleNode={declaredFace}` from the header | 5: four face pins in components ("expected 'usr_9f3' to be 'Ada Lovelace'") and the fields end-to-end card | 11 controls |
| drop `setFieldReadFaceResolver(resolveDeclaredFieldFace);` in fields | 2: the registered-face answer and the end-to-end card | 3 |
| answer the default face too (`return face;`) | 1: "expected [Function TextCellRenderer] to be undefined" | 4 |
| chip draws `{title}` only | 1: the slot pin | 1 |

Chromium (preinstalled `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`): a scratch Vite entry, never committed and deleted after, mounted the real `RecordDetailView` from `@object-ui/app-shell` over a stub data source. The record was a `sys_record_share` with `recipient_id: 'usr_9f3'`, `recipient_type: 'user'`, and `sys_user` answering `{ id: 'usr_9f3', name: 'Ada Lovelace' }`.

- At the head: the H1 first read `usr_9f3` while the lazy face loaded, then `Ada Lovelace`. Its markup was the face's own truncating `span`, and the page logged no errors. The face read `sys_user` once.
- Control, with the rung ablated and the served module confirmed to carry zero `titleNode: declaredFace`: the H1 stayed `usr_9f3` for the whole 10 s window.
- After the restore, it read `Ada Lovelace` again.

## Docs

- `packages/components/README.md`: a "Record heading through a field's face" section under Layout Components. Its snippet compiles under `--strict` against the built `dist`, with a red control.
- `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx`: the derived record heading's widget-face rule.
- `content/docs/guide/fields.md`: "A widget's face on the record heading". The `docs:check-links` gate judges the cross-page anchor; a misspelt anchor turned it red, and the real one passes.

## Changeset

`.changeset/13216-header-widget-face.md`:

- `@object-ui/components` is `minor`, because the PR adds new exports and a new prop. The CONTRIBUTING versioning section makes a new feature `minor`, and `major` is never declared.
- `@object-ui/fields` is `patch`: it adds no export, and its behaviour changes.

## Acceptance notes

- The breadcrumb, favourite and recent-item labels for a record share still read the stored user id (H4). They derive from `getRecordDisplayName` in `RecordDetailView`, outside this claim's file surface, and no synchronous label exists for them. This is a code reading, not filed: no carrier.
- `@object-ui/types`' `FieldMetadata` declares no `widget` member, although the spec's field declares one. The seam therefore types `field` as `FieldMetadata` (the registry's own `CellRendererProps.field`), and the fields resolver reads the widget through `resolveCellRendererType`. That is an observation only, not filed.

The record share's heading defect was first measured by the maintainer's HotCRM pass (objectstack-ai/objectstack#24701). This change was implemented by a dispatched `os-dev` run for objectui `domain:ui` seat 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014MXhk1yjWh37d634hLy3p7`.
